eligibility.held_out_only: Model_Split == test; the STK11 case-study variants are on training probes and are excluded
eligibility.non_truncating_only: Ter/fs variants are pathogenic by protein truncation; their ClinVar call is not evidence about methylation

power_statement: at n=35, a mean percentile of 65 is ~3 SE from the null and detectable; 58 is not. A null result does NOT distinguish no enrichment from underpowered and must be reported as inconclusive.
primary_statistic: count of variants with matched-background tail probability < 0.05, against a binomial null of 0.05; two-sided
secondary_statistic: mean matched-background percentile against a null of 50
status: PRE-REGISTERED -- written before any matched-background score for this cohort existed
